caption:
You already have someone answering the phones.

So why bring up automated follow-up at all?

That person can only handle one lead at a time. They take lunch. They go home at 5. They can't watch a call, a text, and a form fill land in the same minute.

Automation catches the lead the moment your team is tied up, then hands the conversation back to a real person.

Want a real look at where your leads are slipping through right now?

rationale: Carousels lead saves/depth for B2B educational content in 2026 benchmarks, and this fills the under-served Objection Handling slot with a genuinely unclaimed objection (staff redundancy) distinct from the cost, impersonal, timing, tried-and-failed, complexity, and lock-in objections already shipped.
